SELECT 
    rm.match_rec_registry,
    rm.donor_ref_reg AS donor_id,
    rm.recip_ref_reg AS patient_id,
    rm.level_val,
    re.org_qual_val,

WHERE rm.level_val = 'Marginal'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    rm.donor_ref_reg AS donor_id,
    rm.recip_ref_reg AS patient_id,
    re.org_qual_val,
    re.egs_val,
    re.eps_val,
    re.surg_cmpl_val,
    cl.med_urgency,
    cl.wait_time,
    CASE 
        WHEN cl.med_urgency = 'Status 1A' THEN 5
        WHEN cl.med_urgency = 'Status 1B' THEN 4
        WHEN cl.med_urgency = '2' THEN 3
        WHEN cl.med_urgency = 'Status 2' THEN 3
        WHEN cl.med_urgency = '3' THEN 2
        WHEN cl.med_urgency = 'Status 3' THEN 2
        ELSE 1
    END AS status_medical,
    CAST(SPLIT_PART(cl.wait_time, ' ', 1) AS INTEGER) / 365.0 AS r_wait
FROM transplant_matching rm
JOIN risk_evaluation re ON rm.match_rec_registry = re.risk_eval_registry
JOIN clinical cl ON rm.recip_ref_reg = cl.clin_recip_registry
WHERE rm.level_val = 'Marginal'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    rm.donor_ref_reg AS donor_id,
    rm.recip_ref_reg AS patient_id,
    re.org_qual_val,
    re.egs_val,
    re.eps_val,
    re.surg_cmpl_val,
    cl.med_urgency,
    cl.wait_time,
    CASE 
        WHEN cl.med_urgency = 'Status 1A' THEN 5
        WHEN cl.med_urgency = 'Status 1B' THEN 4
        WHEN cl.med_urgency = '2' THEN 3
        WHEN cl.med_urgency = 'Status 2' THEN 3
        WHEN cl.med_urgency = '3' THEN 2
        WHEN cl.med_urgency = 'Status 3' THEN 2
        ELSE 1
    END AS status_medical,
    ROUND(CAST(
        (CASE 
            WHEN cl.med_urgency = 'Status 1A' THEN 5
            WHEN cl.med_urgency = 'Status 1B' THEN 4
            WHEN cl.med_urgency = '2' THEN 3
            WHEN cl.med_urgency = 'Status 2' THEN 3
            WHEN cl.med_urgency = '3' THEN 2
            WHEN cl.med_urgency = 'Status 3' THEN 2
            ELSE 1
        END) * 0.7 + 0.3 * (CAST(SPLIT_PART(cl.wait_time, ' ', 1) AS INTEGER) / 365.0)
    AS numeric), 4) AS urgency_score
FROM transplant_matching rm

JOIN clinical cl ON rm.recip_ref_reg = cl.clin_recip_registry
WHERE rm.level_val = 'Marginal'
ORDER BY urgency_score DESC
LIMIT 10;
